job_description: Founded in 2012, H2O.ai is on a mission to democratize AI. As the world’s leading agentic AI company, H2O.ai converges Generative and Predictive AI to help enterprises and public sector agencies develop purpose-built GenAI applications on their private data. With a focus on Sovereign AI—secure, compliant, and infrastructure-flexible deployments—H2O.ai delivers solutions that align with the highest standards of data privacy and control. Our open-source technology is trusted by over 20,000 organizations worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 500. H2O.ai powers AI transformation for companies like AT&T, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Chipotle, Workday, Progressive Insurance, and NIH. H2O.ai partners include NVIDIA, Dell Technologies, Deloitte, Ernst & Young (EY), Snowflake, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), VAST Data and MinIO. H2O.ai’s AI for Good program supports nonprofit groups, foundations, and communities in advancing education, healthcare, and environmental conservation. With a vibrant community of 2 million data scientists worldwide, H2O.ai aims to co-create valuable AI applications for all users. H2O.ai has raised 256 million from investors, including Commonwealth Bank, NVIDIA, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo, Capital One, Nexus Ventures and New York Life. About This Opportunity Are you passionate about building scalable, cutting-edge AI-solutions and eager to make an impact on an innovative product? Join us as a Software Engineer to help revive and deliver critical products to our enterprise customers. You will work alongside experienced Software Engineers who will guide and orchestrate the team’s efforts in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. If you love solving tough problems, working with modern tech like Kubernetes, Go, Python, and streaming platforms, and want to be part of a team that moves fast, this role is for you! This position is based in Sri Lanka. What You Will Do Build & ship: Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of scalable applications using Kubernetes, Go, Python, Protobuf, gRPC, and REST API.Think in microservices: Help design and maintain scalable microservices architecture.Work with real-world big data: Optimize and process large datasets efficiently.Get hands-on with streaming data: Work with Kafka and real-time data processing (we’ll teach you if you’re new to it!).Deploy like a pro: Use Helm to deploy and manage Kubernetes applications.Work like a pro: Debug, test, and refine software to ensure high code quality and reliability.Learn & grow: Work closely with a seasoned Senior Engineer who will mentor and support you.What We Are Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent work experience).5+ years of software development experience (or solid projects if you’re a fast learner!).Proficiency in Java, Go, Python, Kubernetes, Protobuf, gRPC, REST API, and micro-services architecture.Passion for data-heavy applications and handling large datasets.Familiarity with microservices architecture and distributed systems.Bonus points if you’ve worked with Kafka or Helm (but if not, we’ll help you learn!).Knowledge of JVM-based languages is advantageous but optional.A growth mindset – we don’t expect you to know everything, but we expect you to be excited to learn.Why H2O.ai? Market leader in total rewardsRemote-friendly cultureFlexible working environmentBe part of a world-class teamCareer growthH2O.ai is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. H2O.ai is an innovative AI cloud platform company, leading the mission to democratize AI for everyone. Thousands of organizations worldwide have utilized our cutting-edge technology across various industries. We’ve made it easy for people at all levels to generate breakthrough solutions to complex business problems and advance the discovery of new ideas and revenue streams. We push the boundaries of what is possible with artificial intelligence. H2O.ai employs the world’s top Kaggle Grandmasters, the community of best-in-the-world machine learning practitioners and data scientists. A strong AI for Good ethos and a responsible approach to AI drive the company’s purpose. Please visit www.H2O.ai to learn more. #LI-Hybrid For information about how H2O.ai collects, uses, and protects your personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice.

job_description: Senior Software Engineer: As a Senior Software Engineer at Thomson Reuters, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and improving software systems and applications for our global customers. You will work closely with a team of talented engineers to build and deliver high-quality products on a scale. We are looking for motivated individuals who thrive on solving complex problems, enjoy collaborating with others, have strong communication skills, and are eager to learn and apply new technologies. If you love writing code and are interested in building large-scale distributed systems, we would like to speak with you! About the Role In this opportunity as a Senior Software Engineer, you will: Partner with business and technology stakeholders to design scalable, resilient, and high-performing software solutions with strong product and domain understanding Contribute to the technical design and hands-on implementation of key initiatives, working closely with product owners, architects, and engineering teams Drive engineering excellence through high-quality code contributions, thorough code reviews, robust testing strategies, and continuous improvement practices Apply and promote industry best practices, coding standards, and development processes across projects Mentor and support junior engineers through knowledge sharing, technical guidance, and constructive feedback Collaborate with the team to deliver high-quality software solutions, support sound technical decisions, and ensure timely execution of project milestones Participate in Agile ceremonies and planning sessions with Product Owners and engineering teams to align priorities, technical feasibility, and delivery goals Identify technical risks, contribute mitigation strategies, and help resolve complex engineering challenges Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and operational excellence within the team. About You You're fit for the role of Senior Software Engineer if your background includes: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or computer engineering 3+ years of hands-on software development experience with a strong track record of delivering scalable and reliable software solutions Proven experience contributing to the design and delivery of complex software projects and distributed systems Strong software engineering skills with the ability to work independently, collaborate effectively, and contribute to technical decision-making Advanced proficiency in JVM-based languages such as Java and Scala Interest in working with Scala and willingness to explore functional programming paradigms Deep understanding of software design patterns, architectural principles, and system design best practices Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and containerization technologies such as Docker Strong expertise in relational database management systems Good understanding of enterprise architecture concepts including scalability, system integration, security, reliability, and testing strategies Proficiency with Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and version control systems Strong commitment to writing clean, maintainable, testable, and well-documented code Experience implementing automated testing and quality assurance practices across the development lifecycle Ability to quickly learn, adapt, and work effectively in changing technologies, business needs, and priorities Agile mindset with the flexibility to manage shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and organizational levels. #LI-BD1 What’s in it For You? Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. About Us Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace. We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here. Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here. More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com. At Thomson Reuters, we’re not riding the AI wave — we’re reshaping the future of professional work across law, tax, compliance, and journalism. Here, you will collaborate with smart, ambitious people who thrive on solving complex problems, delivering market-leading solutions, and innovating with curiosity and care. job_description: We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with strong expertise in MuleSoft for our client in New Zealand. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining MuleSoft applications to support our clients’ business needs. You will work on enterprise-level integrations that enable global operations, modern digital channels, and cloud-based systems. This role offers the opportunity to work on large-scale, real-world integrations, collaborate with experienced architects and engineers. Key Responsibilities: • Design, develop, customize, and deploy MuleSoft applications, APIs, and integrations using Anypoint Platform. • Build scalable and maintainable integration solutions following MuleSoft and enterprise integration best practices. • Develop reusable components, shared assets, and common frameworks to support multiple projects. • Create proofs of concept (PoCs) to evaluate new integration patterns, MuleSoft features, and technologies. • Use approved AI-assisted development tools, where appropriate, to support API design, integration development, documentation, test scenario creation, troubleshooting, and productivity improvement. • Review, validate, and refine AI-generated suggestions, documentation, code snippets, or API specifications to ensure accuracy, security, maintainability, and alignment with MuleSoft best practices. • Collaborate with product owners, architects, QA, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and implement user stories. • Participate in agile ceremonies including stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. • Ensure timely delivery of assigned tasks while maintaining high-quality standards. • Provide technical support during development, testing, deployment, and post-production phases. • Troubleshoot MuleSoft-related issues, resolve defects, and implement workarounds when required. • Support deployments and releases to customer environments, including cloud and hybrid setups. • Create and maintain technical and operational documentation. • Stay current with MuleSoft platform updates, integration patterns, and industry trends. What We Expect: • 3+ years of hands-on experience in MuleSoft development (Anypoint Studio and Anypoint Platform). • Strong expertise in Mule ESB, SOA, and API-led connectivity. • Experience designing and developing complex MuleSoft integrations. • Proficient in REST, SOAP, RAML, XML, JSON, and XSD. • Hands-on experience with Java, DataWeave, Anypoint Studio, and CloudHub. • Solid understanding of middleware concepts and RDBMS. • Adherence to MuleSoft best practices, governance, and guardrails. • Demonstrated experience in delivering high-quality integration solutions with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • Effective communicator with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams. • Awareness of AI-assisted software development practices and willingness to use approved AI tools responsibly to improve productivity and delivery quality. • Ability to critically review AI-generated outputs before using them in development, documentation, testing, or delivery activities. • Understanding of security, data privacy, and governance considerations when using AI tools in enterprise environments. • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Nice to Have: • MuleSoft Certification. • Experience with Salesforce APIs. • Knowledge of API security. • Experience Working with TypeScript and Node.js • Experience with monitoring and logging tools. • Exposure to Agile / Scrum delivery models. • Experience supporting global or multi-region integration platforms.

Job Description **Job Description – Software Engineer (Backend) Software Engineers at IFS transform product visions and roadmaps into high‑quality, maintainable, and scalable software capabilities. They interpret functional and technical requirements to design and implement enterprise‑grade backend software while ensuring performance, security, maintainability, and usability. This role specifically includes basic DevOps competencies (CI/CD, cloud awareness, deployment automation, observability fundamentals) to ensure strong collaboration with platform engineering, quality engineering, and operational teams. This is not a DevOps role but a backend engineer role with operational and automation awareness. Automated testing and code coverage understanding is must. Summary A Software Engineer (Backend) at IFS designs, develops, tests, and maintains backend components of IFS products. The role includes writing clean, efficient, secure, and scalable code, participating in design and code reviews, and applying sound engineering principles. Engineers also contribute to improving the codebase, documentation, and development processes. They take part in automation and pipeline efficiency by applying foundational DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and cloud‑ready development. The engineer proactively prevents issues and resolves them quickly when they arise. They **Essential Duties & Accountabilities 1. Backend Software Design & Development Design and develop backend services and components based on functional and technical requirements. Ensure performance, security, maintainability, and scalability. Use established software engineering best practices, patterns, and architectural guidelines. Take ownership of assigned tasks and contribute to technical initiatives. 2. Testing, Debugging & Code Quality Debug and resolve backend issues; evaluate alternative solutions where necessary. Ensure appropriate test coverage (unit, integration, API tests). Participate in code reviews, contributing constructive improvement feedback. 3. DevOps‑Related Responsibilities (Foundational Level) (Adapted from DevOps responsibilities but proportionate to a Software Engineer role) Use and contribute to CI/CD pipelines for automated building, testing, and deployment. Write backend code that is cloud‑ready, container‑ready, instrumented for logging and monitoring. Apply fundamental DevSecOps practices (dependency scanning, secure coding, basic automation). Collaborate closely with DevOps/platform engineering to ensure smooth releases and efficient developer experience. 4. AI‑Driven Engineering Responsibilities Use of recommended AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Any Given commercial tools) AI‑assisted coding, refactoring, testing, documentation AI‑powered architecture/design review AI‑enabled observability & anomaly detection Experimentation with new AI capabilities Continuous feedback loop into engineering leadership Alignment with emerging IFS platform AI strategy Fully aligned with: Your previous Software Engineer (mid) scope DevOps foundations AI adoption expectations for modern engineering teams 5. Documentation Create and maintain technical documentation including API specs, architecture decisions, and system-level designs. 6. Stakeholder Engagement Work with requirement owners, architects, and QA to ensure functional fit and technical quality. Provide solution options and participate in technical estimations. Support prototyping and early validation efforts. 7. Knowledge Sharing & Collaboration Share knowledge with peers, mentor junior team members at a basic‑to‑intermediate level. Promote good engineering practices and continuous improvement. 8. Product/Program Contribution Assist in product-related market understanding and provide inputs into technical direction. Required Competence Areas Using the Software Engineer competency matrix as baseline. 1. Technical Design & Programming Strong analytical, logical, and problem‑solving skills. Proficiency in at least one backend programming language. Understanding of algorithms, data structures, design patterns. 2. Documentation Ability to document code, design choices, and architecture decisions. 3. Performance, Reliability & Security Understanding of caching, indexing, scalability concepts. Familiarity with secure coding and OWASP basics. 4. DevOps & Cloud Fundamentals Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and ability to contribute to build/test automation. Basic containerization skills (Docker) and cloud‑ready design patterns. Familiarity with observability basics (logs, metrics, traces). Exposure to infrastructure-as-code or cloud environments is a plus (Terraform, Azure, etc.). 5. Collaboration & Leadership Able to participate in technical discussions and offer inputs. Provides support to less experienced engineers. Works independently on medium complexity tasks. Required Education & Experience Essential University degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. Experience in software development lifecycle. Understanding of DevOps principles (CI/CD, automation). Strong problem‑solving skills and willingness to learn. Desirable Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred). Experience with backend frameworks, REST APIs, microservices. Familiarity with agile methodologies. Knowledge of secure coding and testing practices. Qualifications University degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. Job Description **Job Description – Software Engineer (Backend) Software Engineers at IFS transform product visions and roadmaps into high‑quality, maintainable, and scalable software capabilities. They interpret functional and technical requirements to design and implement enterprise‑grade backend software while ensuring performance, security, maintainability, and usability. This role specifically includes basic DevOps competencies (CI/CD, cloud awareness, deployment automation, observability fundamentals) to ensure strong collaboration with platform engineering, quality engineering, and operational teams. This is not a DevOps role but a backend engineer role with operational and automation awareness. Automated testing and code coverage understanding is must. Summary A Software Engineer (Backend) at IFS designs, develops, tests, and maintains backend components of IFS products. The role includes writing clean, efficient, secure, and scalable code, participating in design and code reviews, and applying sound engineering principles. Engineers also contribute to improving the codebase, documentation, and development processes. They take part in automation and pipeline efficiency by applying foundational DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and cloud‑ready development. The engineer proactively prevents issues and resolves them quickly when they arise. They **Essential Duties & Accountabilities 1. Backend Software Design & Development Design and develop backend services and components based on functional and technical requirements. Ensure performance, security, maintainability, and scalability. Use established software engineering best practices, patterns, and architectural guidelines. Take ownership of assigned tasks and contribute to technical initiatives. 2. Testing, Debugging & Code Quality Debug and resolve backend issues; evaluate alternative solutions where necessary. Ensure appropriate test coverage (unit, integration, API tests). Participate in code reviews, contributing constructive improvement feedback. 3. DevOps‑Related Responsibilities (Foundational Level) (Adapted from DevOps responsibilities but proportionate to a Software Engineer role) Use and contribute to CI/CD pipelines for automated building, testing, and deployment. Write backend code that is cloud‑ready, container‑ready, instrumented for logging and monitoring. Apply fundamental DevSecOps practices (dependency scanning, secure coding, basic automation). Collaborate closely with DevOps/platform engineering to ensure smooth releases and efficient developer experience. 4. AI‑Driven Engineering Responsibilities Use of recommended AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Any Given commercial tools) AI‑assisted coding, refactoring, testing, documentation AI‑powered architecture/design review AI‑enabled observability & anomaly detection Experimentation with new AI capabilities Continuous feedback loop into engineering leadership Alignment with emerging IFS platform AI strategy Fully aligned with: Your previous Software Engineer (mid) scope DevOps foundations AI adoption expectations for modern engineering teams 5. Documentation Create and maintain technical documentation including API specs, architecture decisions, and system-level designs. 6. Stakeholder Engagement Work with requirement owners, architects, and QA to ensure functional fit and technical quality. Provide solution options and participate in technical estimations. Support prototyping and early validation efforts. 7. Knowledge Sharing & Collaboration Share knowledge with peers, mentor junior team members at a basic‑to‑intermediate level. Promote good engineering practices and continuous improvement. 8. Product/Program Contribution Assist in product-related market understanding and provide inputs into technical direction. Required Competence Areas Using the Software Engineer competency matrix as baseline. 1. Technical Design & Programming Strong analytical, logical, and problem‑solving skills. Proficiency in at least one backend programming language. Understanding of algorithms, data structures, design patterns. 2. Documentation Ability to document code, design choices, and architecture decisions. 3. Performance, Reliability & Security Understanding of caching, indexing, scalability concepts. Familiarity with secure coding and OWASP basics. 4. DevOps & Cloud Fundamentals Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and ability to contribute to build/test automation. Basic containerization skills (Docker) and cloud‑ready design patterns. Familiarity with observability basics (logs, metrics, traces). Exposure to infrastructure-as-code or cloud environments is a plus (Terraform, Azure, etc.). 5. Collaboration & Leadership Able to participate in technical discussions and offer inputs. Provides support to less experienced engineers. Works independently on medium complexity tasks. Required Education & Experience Essential University degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. Experience in software development lifecycle. Understanding of DevOps principles (CI/CD, automation). Strong problem‑solving skills and willingness to learn. Desirable Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred). Experience with backend frameworks, REST APIs, microservices. Familiarity with agile methodologies. Knowledge of secure coding and testing practices. Qualifications University degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. Additional Information We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

job_description: iLabs is a global software product engineering company headquartered in Sri Lanka, with deep roots in the US Silicon Valley. We deliver world-class solutions in Web, eCommerce, Mobile, AI/ML, and Cloud technologies, serving industries such as fintech, edtech, medtech, martech, and hospitality. Guided by our vision to become a global powerhouse in information technology to push humanity forward we focus on delivering innovative, impactful solutions that empower businesses and create meaningful change in the world. With a global talent network, we build agile remote teams for leading tech companies worldwide, including Silicon Valley pioneers. Our in-house ventures include Cloud of Goods, a fast-growing eCommerce rental marketplace, and Xenia, a customizable web platform for modern businesses. At iLabs, we're on a mission to advance lifestyles through technology and empower our partners to scale smarter and faster. Our culture is driven by creativity, innovation, ownership, teamwork, and global impact; giving you the opportunity and freedom to challenge the norm, spark change, and make a real difference. If you're ready to break boundaries and create your defining moment, we're here to make it happen. Be part of something bigger. Join iLabs Be part of something bigger. Join iLabs. Responsibilities Collaborate with cross-functional teams, product managers, designers, and stakeholders to gather, analyze, and refine software requirements. Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance full-stack software solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and React, including backend services and APIs. Develop modern, responsive, and user-friendly frontend applications using React.js and related technologies. Design and implement microservices-based architectures that support scalability, maintainability, and system resilience. Ensure software quality through unit testing, integration testing, code reviews, and adherence to engineering best practices. Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications across the full technology stack. Work closely with distributed teams and global clients to deliver high-quality software products on schedule. Leverage AI-powered engineering tools, coding assistants, and AI agents to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and problem-solving workflows. Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices that improve team effectiveness and product quality. Contribute to architectural discussions, technical decision-making, and continuous improvement initiatives. Shift: SL day time (9am - 6pm) Location: Battaramulla (On-Site) Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Minimum of 2+ years of professional experience in Full Stack software development. Strong expertise in React.js and modern frontend development practices. Solid understanding of Microservices Architecture, RESTful APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven design principles. Experience working with web technologies including AJAX, JSON, HTTP, and responsive web design. Familiarity with modern frontend build tools and ecosystems such as Webpack, Babel, npm, and related technologies. Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar. Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, design patterns, version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies. Demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable, scalable, and testable code. Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Windsurf, or similar AI engineering tools) to enhance software delivery and developer productivity. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and debugging skills. Excellent verbal and written English communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with global teams, clients, and stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Experience designing and deploying cloud-native applications and microservices. Familiarity with messaging and event-streaming technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar platforms.

job_description: Who We Are: Amused Group is a fast-growing online wagering and technology company operating across Australia and international markets. We build and scale high-performance platforms across sports and racing, backed by a culture of accountability, speed, and continuous improvement. We operate as a global, remote-first team and are focused on delivering outcomes, not just activity. Who You Are: You are a mobile-first full-stack engineer with extensive experience building and shipping high-quality cross-platform mobile applications using React Native. You understand that delivering production-grade mobile applications occasionally requires working directly within the native Android and iOS projects, and you are comfortable troubleshooting platform-specific issues, integrating native SDKs, and implementing native enhancements when required. You have a solid understanding of the complete mobile application lifecycle, including testing, release management, code signing, and publishing applications to both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. You are equally comfortable building modern web applications using React (or similar frameworks), creating engaging, performant, and intuitive user experiences. You have strong expertise in the Node.js ecosystem, with the knowledge and experience needed to design and build highly performant, scalable, and maintainable backend services and APIs. You are an architect capable of identifying edge cases and designing for non-functional requirements such as scalability, resilience, security, observability, and performance. You have hands-on experience designing and developing highly scalable, resilient, event-driven distributed systems. You have a deep knowledge of AWS and its services. You understand technology at a fundamental level, enabling you to troubleshoot problems across the entire stack—from mobile and web applications to backend services, cloud infrastructure, networking, and deployment pipelines. You have experience with modern software development methodologies such as spec-driven development or AI-assisted development, and are adept at using AI-powered development tools (i.e. Cursor, Kiro, Claude Code etc.) to accelerate delivery and improve code quality. You stay current with emerging technologies and continuously evaluate new tools and approaches that improve engineering productivity. You are self-motivated, committed to continuous learning, and have a deep respect for quality and commitments. You enjoy constantly pushing the boundaries of your comfort zone. You have excellent written communication skills and can produce clear technical documentation, implementation guides, and design specifications. What You Will Do: Design, develop, and maintain high-quality cross-platform mobile applications using React Native. Work within native Android (Kotlin/Java) and iOS (Swift/Objective-C) projects to troubleshoot platform-specific issues, integrate native SDKs, and implement native enhancements where required. Contribute to the complete mobile application delivery lifecycle, including build automation, code signing, TestFlight, Play Console, App Store Connect, version management, publishing, and post-production support. Design, develop, and maintain modern web applications using React. Design, develop, and maintain low-latency APIs and microservices using Node.js as part of scalable distributed systems. Build reusable components and shared libraries across web and mobile platforms where appropriate. Write and continuously improve unit, integration, and end-to-end tests across backend, web, and mobile applications. Own the components you build through to production and provide post go-live support. Leverage AI-assisted development practices (e.g., spec-driven workflows and prompt-driven coding with GitHub Copilot or Amazon Q) to accelerate delivery while improving design and implementation quality. Promote automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and engineering best practices throughout the software development lifecycle. What You Need to Have: A minimum of 5 years of professional software engineering experience building production-grade applications. Extensive hands-on experience developing production React Native applications. Demonstrated experience publishing and maintaining mobile applications on both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Strong understanding of the mobile application release lifecycle, including code signing, certificates, provisioning profiles, TestFlight, Play Console, App Store Connect, application versioning, and production deployments. Practical experience working within native Android and iOS projects to troubleshoot platform-specific issues, integrate third-party SDKs, configure native modules, and implement platform-specific functionality. Working knowledge of Kotlin or Java for Android and Swift or Objective-C for iOS, sufficient to debug, extend, and maintain React Native applications. Strong experience building modern web applications using React (or similar frameworks). Strong experience developing backend services using Node.js and TypeScript. Experience integrating mobile and web applications with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, authentication systems, push notifications, deep linking, secure storage, background processing, and native device capabilities. Strong cloud experience on AWS with Docker and Kubernetes. AWS certification would be an advantage. Hands-on experience designing event-driven architectures, asynchronous communication patterns, and resilient distributed systems. Strong understanding of software design principles including SOLID, GRASP, Clean/Hexagonal Architecture, and GoF design patterns. Solid understanding of performance optimization techniques, including horizontal scaling, caching, indexing, compression, asynchronous processing, and frontend/mobile performance optimization. In-depth knowledge of HTTP, REST, WebSockets, gRPC, and modern API design best practices. Proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, React Native, Node.js, relational and NoSQL databases, messaging technologies, and AWS-native services. Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, Kiro, Claude Code) as part of a modern software engineering workflow. Experience with Git, collaborative development workflows, and CI/CD pipelines. Good understanding of mobile and web application security, secure storage, authentication, and common security protocols. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, emerging technologies, and engineering best practices. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Why Join Amused Group? Fully remote, global team environment. USD-based compensation. Opportunity to build and scale delivery practices in a fast-growing company.

job_description: About Us We are Yokohama TWS, a leading global supplier of tires and complete wheels for the agricultural, material handling, construction, motorcycles segments. We design and manufacture tire and wheel solutions made for the future. With a combination of value, safety and ease, our solutions provide a more productive and sustainable performance our customers demand. We pair the expertise and power of our global reach with the care and knowledge of local proximity. This brings innovation, technology and sustainability together to answer the specific needs of our customers. All while continuing to reduce our and their impact on the planet. Our people take ownership to deliver on this promise every day. We are a global Company with a local reach, operating in more than 50 Countries worldwide with 5.300 employees of 40 different nationalities, 12 state-of-the-art plants and 4 innovation centers. We are part of Yokohama Rubber Co., Ltd., a global leader in the tire industry with 1094 billion yen in revenues (approx. 6.7 billion euro), approximately 34,000 people around the globe and with operations in more than 120 countries. If you have an entrepreneurial mindset, enjoy taking responsibilities and getting things done in the right way, join us! We are plenty of opportunities to grow and develop in a truly dynamic and easy-going environment. About The Opportunity The role requires solid and proven experience in Data Analysis, with the primary objective of translating insights into business strategies and optimizing supply chain performance. The ideal candidate must therefore understand the functional aspects connected to the company’s core business, ensuring full alignment with supply chain and operational objectives. YOUR ROLE AND IMPACT Collect, validate, and analyze data from transportation, warehousing, inventory, and related operational systems to ensure accuracy and reliability. Translate complex data into clear and actionable insights that support operational planning and business decision-making. Develop, maintain, and regularly update Excel reports, SQL queries, and Power BI dashboards to monitor key performance indicators and operational trends. Identify inefficiencies, cost drivers, service gaps, and performance issues across transportation networks and warehouse operations. Convert operational challenges into structured optimisation problems to improve delivery routes, carrier selection, warehouse space utilisation, and overall resource efficiency. Work closely with Supply Chain, Operations, and IT teams to understand business requirements, improve data processes, and support continuous improvement initiatives. YOUR ELIGIBILITY Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related discipline. 1–2 years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, supply chain, logistics, operations, or IT. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, SQL, and data-visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Sound knowledge of transportation, warehousing, inventory management, and broader supply chain operations. Working knowledge of Python or R for data analysis, automation, and advanced data modelling. Familiarity with ETL tools and processes, including data extraction, transformation, integration, and validation. Basic knowledge of optimization techniques and tools such as Excel Solver. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights. Essential Key Skills And Competencies Data Analytics Tools: Advanced proficiency in Excel, SQL, and Power BI or Tableau.Supply Chain Analytics: Understanding of transportation, warehousing, inventory, and operational KPIs. Programming & Automation: Working knowledge of Python or R, ETL processes, and Excel Solver. Analytical Thinking: Ability to identify trends, solve problems, and translate data into actionable insights. Professional Competencies: Strong communication, collaboration, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. What We Offer A competitive remuneration in line with industry standards, coupled with comprehensive personal and family health insurance. Our commitment extends beyond compensation, as we provide clear learning and development pathways to support your personal and career growth, including training and mentorship from senior data and supply chain experts, hands-on experience in supply chain analytics and multinational operations, and opportunities to learn advanced analytics tools and automation techniques. Moreover, we foster a healthy working environment, ensuring a perfect balance between work and life. How To Apply If you are a dynamic and proactive professional looking to contribute to our organization’s success, we’d love to hear from you. Send in your resume along with a cover letter detailing how you can contribute to our team’s success to [tws.lankahrd@yokohama-tws.com]. About The Application Process Our application process takes pride in transparency and fairness. Besides remote and physical interviews, candidate selection is based on aptitude tests. Yokohama-TWS is an equal-opportunity employer. We rejoice in diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

job_description: Company DescriptionAbout IGT1:IGT1 is a rapidly growing offshore technology and talent solutions company based in Port City Colombo. We are a fully owned subsidiary of IGT I Holdings Sweden AB, funded by the three of world’s leading private equity firms; EQT Group, Hg, and TA Associates. We’re also proud to be a sister company of IFS, Sri Lanka’s largest and most established technology company. At IGT1, we partner with global businesses to provide them with an operation that maximizes efficiency, spurs growth, allows them to develop and deliver world-class product and services, and create long-term value. Our people-first culture champions diversity, teamwork, and continuous learning, creating an environment where talent thrives. With a team of over 500 professionals and counting, we are always looking for passionate, skilled individuals who want to make a global impact while being part of something extraordinary. Through our offshore collaboration model, you'll be embedded within the team of one of our esteemed international clients, contributing directly to high-impact, enterprise-level initiatives.About Rhapsody:Rhapsody Health is at the forefront of revolutionizing healthcare with cutting-edge technology that drives meaningful change. Our platform empowers healthcare providers and patients to enhance care delivery and streamline processes, making a tangible impact on the healthcare landscape. As a B Corporation, we are deeply committed to balancing purpose with profitability, and our global team spans countries including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States, New Zealand and Sri Lanka.Job DescriptionAbout the role:The Senior Cloud Engineer - Networking is responsible for the design, operation, support, and continuous improvement of the network services that underpin Rhapsody’s AWS hosted platforms. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong operational leadership, customer engagement, and incident management capabilities. The successful candidate will serve as a senior member of the Cloud Operations function, leading operational shifts, coordinating cross functional response activities during critical incidents, and acting as a trusted technical point of contact for both internal stakeholders and enterprise customers. The role requires hands on expertise in AWS services including networking, hybrid connectivity, troubleshooting, and automation along with exceptional communication skills, customer facing experience, and the ability to remain composed during high-severity production incidents. Success in this role requires strong networking fundamentals, operational excellence, leadership during service impacting events, and a service-oriented mindset focused on delivering reliable and secure customer outcomes across global time zones. Key Responsibilities Design, configure, and operate AWS networking: VPC/VPCe, Subnets, Route Tables, NACLs, Security Groups, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, NAT, IGW, Route 53, and hybrid connectivity patterns. Build and maintain site‑to‑site VPNs (IPsec) and Direct Connect (with BGP), including failover and HA designs; administer Sophos XG (or equivalent) virtual firewalls. Coordinate incident response activities during P1 and P2 service impacting events, ensuring effective communication, stakeholder engagement, and timely resolution. Provide operational leadership during handovers, ensuring accurate shift transitions, risk identification, and continuity of service. Act as a primary technical liaison for customer-facing networking incidents, escalations, and connectivity projects. Manage Layer‑4/7 traffic using ALB/NLB, AWS WAF, TLS termination, and client/server certificate workflows (PKI). Lead deep‑dive troubleshooting for network connectivity (AWS ↔ customer DC/cloud), packet flow, NAT, routing asymmetry, MTU/fragmentation, TCP/TLS, DNS, and identity‑adjacent issues. Instrument and monitor network health (CloudWatch, VPC Flow Logs, Datadog, firewall logs); respond to alerts, drive rapid mitigation, and provide clear RCA inputs. Execute network changes and environment builds using Terraform and AWS CLI following change controls and maintenance windows. Develop scripts (Bash/Python/PowerShell) for validation checks, log parsing, and configuration hygiene; reduce toil via automation and golden patterns. Maintain auditable documentation (diagrams, SOPs/runbooks, firewall rulesets, cert inventories) and support patching/compliance activities. Work directly with customer IT/network teams to set up connectivity (VPN/DCX), perform cutovers, and resolve issues; explain decisions and trade‑offs clearly. Partner with SRE/Engineering to improve observability, resiliency, and performance; assist Support with network‑centric cases. QualificationsRequired Qualifications 5+ years of experience working within a Service Operations, Network Operations Center, Site Reliability Engineering, Managed Services, or Production Support environment. Demonstrated experience leading technical shifts, coordinating operational activities, or acting as a senior escalation point within a 24x7 support organization. Hands‑on AWS networking experience (VPC/TGW/Route 53/ALB‑NLB/PrivateLink/VPN/Direct Connect/BGP). Strong network fundamentals: TCP/IP, routing (static/BGP), NAT, ACLs, firewalls, DNS, TLS/PKI, IPsec; packet capture/flow analysis (e.g., tcpdump, Wireshark). Proficiency with Bash, Python, Terraform and AWS CLI; Git‑based workflows and change control discipline. Linux administration fundamentals; comfort reading system/app logs. Experience in follow‑the‑sun/24×7 environments with on‑call participation. Excellent written and verbal communication for global and customer‑facing work. Preferred Qualifications Certifications (one or more): AWS Advanced Networking – Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, CCNA/CCNP, Network+, or Fortinet/Sophos equivalents. Experience with Sophos XG (or similar virtual firewall), IPsec/IKEv2 tuning, and HA patterns. Exposure to observability/SIEM/EDR (Datadog, Rapid7, SentinelOne) and security best practices. Familiarity with healthcare integration engines (Rhapsody/Corepoint) or other enterprise SaaS workloads. Scripting beyond basics (Python/Bash) and CI/CD familiarity. ITIL foundation certification Shift & On‑Call Expectations Assigned shift coverage aligned with global operations; occasional shift adjustments for maintenance or projects. Participation in rotational on‑call for P1/P2 events per local policy Precise handoffs and status updates at shift boundaries. Required Educational Qualification:Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field preferred Demonstrated, relevant experience may be substituted for a degree AWS certification preferred (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Advanced Networking – Specialty) Additional InformationWe champion flexibility and hybrid work options to support varying lifestyles and personal needs. At the same time, we value the power of in-person collaboration to build community, spark innovation, and strengthen connections. Our approach ensures you can work in ways that suit you best while still engaging with colleagues to share ideas and grow together. #LI-Hybrid #LI-DNP

job_description: CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients. Why us? 🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally. 🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead. 🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one. 🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success. 💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance. Team: Cloud Engineering Location: Colombo, Sri Lanka Working model: Hybrid — 5 days per month on-site, 9:00am–6:00pm About the RoleWe're hiring a Senior Platform Engineer into our Cloud Engineering team to be a strong individual and team contributor. You'll help drive forward our Cloud strategy and deliverables in the SecDevOps space, engaging with teams across Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, and Product to add strength both inside and outside the core team. Every project moving into Cloud passes through the Cloud Engineering team, making this a highly visible, high-impact role. Based in Colombo, you'll add depth in-region and act as a trusted senior engineer across build, run, and ongoing modernisation initiatives — including our data centre exit and wider Cloud uplift. Key ResponsibilitiesAct as a senior, hands-on engineer in designing, building, and operating systems within the team's scope. Design and manage cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure, with a strong focus on Landing Zone architecture and governance. Build, deploy, and operate containerised applications using Docker and Kubernetes. Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform to enable consistent, repeatable deployments. Implement and support CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub, and manage source code through Git. Design and maintain scalable search and analytics solutions using Elasticsearch. Develop automation scripts using Bash or PowerShell to streamline operational tasks. Contribute to system tooling and automation using a programming language such as Python or Golang. Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability using tools such as Prometheus or New Relic. Ensure systems meet standards for reliability, performance, security, compliance, and recoverability. Take ownership of systems across their lifecycle (build and run), including incident response and root cause analysis. Design and maintain reusable infrastructure patterns and self-service modules for development teams. Plan and implement system changes using structured change control and deployment practices. Maintain and validate backup, recovery, and resilience mechanisms. Identify risks, bottlenecks, and technical debt, and drive continuous improvement. Collaborate with Software Engineers, QA Engineers, and Platform Engineers to align systems with business and application needs. Actively adopt and champion AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cowork) to accelerate delivery and improve quality — reducing instability, errors, and lead times — while helping the wider team upskill. Mentor junior engineers and promote best practices in systems engineering and operations. Skills & CompetenciesEssential 8+ years of experience in systems engineering, platform engineering, or a related field. Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, including Landing Zone design and implementation. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (AKS) and Docker in production environments. Proven experience using Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and management. Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, and Git for CI/CD and version control. Proficiency in scripting using Bash or PowerShell. Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus or New Relic. Strong understanding of system reliability, security, compliance, and operational risk management. Experience operating and supporting business-critical production systems. Ability to automate, optimise, and scale systems effectively. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and trade-offs clearly. Ability to work independently with accountability and sound judgement. A mindset for adopting AI tooling to accelerate and improve engineering delivery. Nice to have Solid experience working with Elasticsearch. Working knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python or Golang. Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) experience. Background in FSI, Energy & Utilities, RegTech, or Professional Services. Why JoinHigh impact, high visibility: All Cloud projects flow through this team — your work directly shapes delivery across the business. Modernisation at scale: Work across a rich, evolving stack — Azure, GitHub Enterprise, Terraform, Kubernetes, Fabric, Foundry, ADF, Synapse, Elasticsearch, AI Search — plus AI-assisted engineering with Claude Code & Cowork. Meaningful initiatives: Contribute to our data centre exit, Cloud uplift and strategy, and other key programmes. Career progression: A clear path from Senior Platform Engineer to Lead Platform Engineer, including people-management responsibilities. Upskilling: Space and support to grow in areas of your interest within the role. Interested? job_description: ## The Big Picture Sysco LABS is the Global In - House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world's largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 56th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry. With over 75,000 associates, 337 smart distribution facilities worldwide, and over 14,000 Io. T-enabled trucks serving 730,000 customer locations, Sysco generated sales of more than $81.4 billion in fiscal year 2025. Sysco LABS Sri Lanka delivers the technology that powers Sysco's end-to-end operations, supporting the company's purpose of "Connecting the world to share food and care for one another." Everything we do directly impacts millions of food consumers in this critical, global industry. ## The Role We're seeking a Technical Business Analyst to join our team at Sysco LABS Sri Lanka. You'll work in a hybrid arrangement, serving as a bridge between product and delivery teams while driving quality-focused solutions across our organization. ## What You'll Be Doing Your day-to-day work will involve liaising with on-site product teams to develop comprehensive product specifications. You'll spend significant time analyzing requirements and converting them into quality business solutions, then effectively documenting and communicating these to project and product teams. Working closely with delivery and product heads, you'll conduct research and development based on our strategic product roadmap, comparing and analyzing competitor products to produce effective business solutions. A key part of your role is coordinating approval processes and articulating user, business, and functional requirements to stakeholders—including management, software engineering teams, and quality assurance. You'll be the single point of contact for requirements, interfacing with onsite staff and maintaining clear communication throughout the organization. You'll take ownership of open issues, working proactively with delivery teams to address key defects and ensure high-level requirements are translated into the necessary level of detail. Planning and managing BA tasks and activities will be core to your responsibilities, with a strong focus on meeting project deadlines while maintaining solution quality. Additionally, you'll manage functional test suites, coordinate in-house training and product demos, and assist with functional and integration test scenario generation and execution. ## What We're Looking For You'll need a Bachelor's Degree in IT, Management, Economics, or Finance—a Master's Degree is an added advantage. We're looking for candidates with 1-2 years of experience in a similar role. Prior experience in software engineering or technical quality engineering roles would be advantageous. You should have hands-on experience working with software models, primarily Agile, RUP, and waterfall methodologies. Professional certifications such as CBAP, PMP, or ACP are a plus. The ability to write complex SQL queries is essential; Cognos experience is a bonus. Beyond technical skills, we need someone with excellent logical and analytical abilities and a sharp eye for detail. Your communication skills—particularly in written and spoken English—should be excellent, with proven experience writing user stories, use cases, and detailed software requirements specifications. You're naturally curious with the ability to rapidly acquire domain business process knowledge, system knowledge, and technical expertise. Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills are important, as is your capacity for leadership, management, and organization. You should be able to troubleshoot integration and application issues, and you have a genuine passion for innovative product design with the ability to foresee business trends. ## What We Offer Compensation is US dollar-linked, with performance rewards and recognition built into our culture. We provide Agile Benefits—special allowances for health, wellness, and academic purposes—along with paid birthday leave and a team engagement allowance. Our comprehensive health and life insurance covers you and extends to parents and in-laws. You'll have overseas travel opportunities and exposure to client environments, working in a hybrid arrangement that balances office and remote time. Sysco LABS is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace.
